dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: What's difficult for you in English, Nam?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌts ˈdɪfɪkəlt fər juː ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ, ˈnɑːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Pronunciation. When I started, I couldn't say "three". It sounded like "tree"!
dialogue.reading: prəˌnʌnsiˈeɪʃən. wɛn aɪ ˈstɑːrtɪd, aɪ ˈkʊdənt ˈseɪ ˈθriː. ɪt ˈsaʊndɪd laɪk ˈtriː!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Your accent is fine now. People can understand you easily.
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈæksɛnt ɪz ˈfaɪn ˈnaʊ. ˈpiːpəl kən ˌʌndərˈstænd juː ˈiːzəli.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you. Grammar is hard, too. And I can't remember new vocabulary.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː. ˈɡræmər ɪz ˈhɑːrd, ˈtuː. ənd aɪ ˈkænt rɪˈmɛmbər ˈnuː voʊˈkæbjəlɛri.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Will I be able to understand movies without subtitles one day?
dialogue.reading: wɪl aɪ bi ˈeɪbəl tu ˌʌndərˈstænd ˈmuːviz wɪˈðaʊt ˈsʌbtaɪtəlz ˈwʌn ˈdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, you will. Last year, you weren't able to understand me very well.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, juː ˈwɪl. ˈlæst ˈjɪr, juː ˈwɜːrnt ˈeɪbəl tu ˌʌndərˈstænd miː ˈvɛri ˈwɛl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's right. Now I can understand almost everything you say!
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈraɪt. ˈnaʊ aɪ kən ˌʌndərˈstænd ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈɛvriθɪŋ juː ˈseɪ!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Listening is a skill. You can practice it every day.
dialogue.reading: ˈlɪsənɪŋ ɪz ə ˈskɪl. juː kən ˈpræktɪs ɪt ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK! Next year, I'll be able to watch movies without subtitles!
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ! ˈnɛkst ˈjɪr, aɪl bi ˈeɪbəl tə ˈwɑːtʃ ˈmuːviz wɪˈðaʊt ˈsʌbtaɪtəlz!
